notebooks.title: Read a well log
notebooks.sentence: Read one gamma-ray curve exactly as it was uploaded, with its units and depth reference, and plot it.
notebooks.data: A synthetic five-sample gamma-ray log, or a log in your project.

notebooks.title: Shale volume from gamma ray
notebooks.sentence: Pick clean and shale values, compare the five methods, publish one result and add a second version with a changed pick.
notebooks.data: A synthetic five-sample gamma-ray log, or a log in your project; publishing creates a result only you can see until you share it.

notebooks.title: Make a wavelet
notebooks.sentence: Compute a 30 Hz Ricker wavelet, check its strongest frequency against the declared one, upload it and add a second version.
notebooks.data: Computed on your computer; uploading creates a wavelet only you can see until you share it.

notebooks.title: Make a wedge model
notebooks.sentence: Take two rocks from a well log, build a wedge model, compute its synthetic with a Ricker wavelet and read the tuning thickness.
notebooks.data: Rock values measured on the HON-GT-01 excerpt, or recomputed from the HON-GT-01 log in your project; publishing creates results only you can see until you share them.
